wars.basis: September 18: South Group took Verolyubovka, establishing the east-flank bridgehead for Druzhkovka encirclement. P27 (November 1 fire control, 72%) on pace; P24 Orekhov (October 15, 68%) holds as southern quarters clear. Two operational clocks running.

September 16-17: Hormuz transit doubled to 12 vessels; Iran-Oman close on joint corridor agreement. IRGC struck a Togo-flagged tanker claiming unauthorized passage. Corridor route and enforcement boundary remain distinct. P9 closed 对 September 15.

July 14 update (July 13 events). GATIA/MSA forces claimed Anefis district (Kidal region, Mali) July 13, operating alongside FAMa and Africa Corps. AES defense ministers validated unified-force agreement Ouagadougou July 13. AES states hold the cities, the budgets, and the gold (SOPAMIB Yako mine, July 9). JNIM's reach remains real; the confederation's combined force is now legally constituted and operationally fielded.
